source_row.rationale: Carbamazepine labeling lists dizziness, disturbances of coordination/unsteadiness, blurred vision and transient diplopia among nervous-system adverse reactions.
source_row.source_detail: Adverse Reactions > most frequently observed adverse reactions; Nervous System — dizziness, unsteadiness/disturbances of coordination, blurred vision and transient diplopia. source_row.stem: A client taking carbamazepine develops new dizziness, diplopia, and unsteady coordination. What is the nurse’s best interpretation?
